items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tina and I were making records anyway for Blue Note, for Freddie Redd.

ctx.x: Who was – Tina. Tina and I were making records anyway for Blue Note, for Freddie Redd. So I had – Freddie was the musical director. So I had no problem at when when Freddie said, “Jackie, would you mind if Tina was your understudy.” I said, “Hell no, man. I’d love him to be my” – so I would go off and make these other gigs, and Tina would do the gig for me.
One of those gigs led you to Boston. Is that not correct?
